name: STL Scale Engine
shortDescription: Free browser-based STL scale converter for 3D printed miniatures.
description: Convert between 15+ gaming scales with accurate percentages. Supports eye-level and top-of-head measurement modes with material compensation for filament shrinkage.

name: Scale Reference
shortDescription: Complete reference of all miniature scale conversions.
description: Browse all 44 verified conversion percentages between gaming and ratio scales. Each conversion includes math proof, contextual guidance, and printing tips.

name: Slicer Percentage Calculator
shortDescription: Calculate exact slicer percentages for custom scale conversions.
description: Enter any source and target measurements to calculate the exact scaling percentage for your slicer. Works with any two measurements, not just standard scales.

name: Filament Cost Calculator
shortDescription: Estimate filament cost per miniature based on weight and material price.
description: Calculate the approximate filament cost for your 3D printed miniatures based on filament weight, spool price, and model volume.
